item.title: 26 Roydene Rd, feral family, anti social behaviour chuck rubbish on the street, 24th September
item.description:
26 Roydene Road, feral family, irresponsible landlord! Family make constant noise! Adults screaming at one another late into the night. Small child sobbing late into the night (very distressing, very concerned for the welfare of the child)! As is visible from pictures mattress/ bed were placed in front garden and subsequently discarded on street! What are you going to do about this GREENWICH COUNCIL!!! Why have you relocated these people into a peaceful suburban street! Everyone has to suffer because of their ANTISOCIAL BEHAVIOUR! Why did you send these people here without proper supervision. Please come and check on the kids!

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Roydene Road, Plumstead
